evals.prompt: The queue retry fix is staged and ready. Current staged diff stat: /opt/private/coordination/skill-evals/commit/evals/fixtures/staged-stat.txt. Assume CodeRabbit returns what is shown in /opt/private/coordination/skill-evals/commit/evals/fixtures/cr-pass.txt. Run the /commit flow.
evals.expected_output: Agent checks the staged changes, runs CodeRabbit review before committing, then proposes or asks for a commit message and commits with the co-author trailer.

assertions.name: checks-staged-changes-first
assertions.description: Response inspects or summarizes the staged diff before moving into review/commit

assertions.name: runs-coderabbit-before-commit
assertions.description: Response performs CodeRabbit review as a gating step before any commit

assertions.name: prompts-for-or-generates-commit-message-after-review
assertions.description: Response waits until the review passes before generating or requesting the commit message

assertions.name: includes-coauthor-trailer
assertions.description: Response includes the co-author trailer in the final commit command or commit message

evals.prompt: Use /commit for the staged auth cleanup. CodeRabbit output is in /opt/private/coordination/skill-evals/commit/evals/fixtures/cr-fail.txt.
evals.expected_output: Agent surfaces the CodeRabbit issues, does not auto-commit, and asks whether the user wants to proceed anyway despite the failed review.

assertions.name: surfaces-coderabbit-findings
assertions.description: Response shows or summarizes the review issues rather than hiding them behind a generic failure

assertions.name: blocks-automatic-commit-on-review-fail
assertions.description: Response does not proceed straight to commit after a failed CodeRabbit review

assertions.name: asks-user-whether-to-override
assertions.description: Response explicitly asks the user whether they want to proceed anyway

evals.prompt: Please commit the logging cleanup. Current git status is in /opt/private/coordination/skill-evals/commit/evals/fixtures/no-staged-status.txt.
evals.expected_output: Agent notices that nothing is staged, declines to run the review/commit flow, and tells the user to stage files first.

assertions.name: requires-staged-changes
assertions.description: Response checks for staged content before attempting CodeRabbit or commit

assertions.name: does-not-run-review-without-staged-diff
assertions.description: Response does not pretend to perform the review flow when there is no staged diff

assertions.name: tells-user-to-stage-first
assertions.description: Response clearly instructs the user to stage the intended files before invoking the skill
